title: Daily R3: three falling RSI(2) readings ending below 10, in 200-day uptrend

source.title: R3 ETF Strategy (TradingView open-source script, after Connors and Alvarez)

rule_summary: All signals from closed daily candles (UTC) built from 1h data, executed at next 1h open. Compute RSI(2) on daily closes and SMA(200 days) of daily close. ENTRY when a daily candle closes with: close > SMA200 AND RSI(2) has fallen on each of the last three days (RSI today < RSI yesterday < RSI two days ago < RSI three days ago) AND RSI(2) three days ago was below 60 AND RSI(2) today is below 10, with no open position. EXIT when a daily close has RSI(2) above 70. No stop, no profit target. One position per pair, whole balance.
mechanism: A multi-day one-way slide that ends in extreme short-term oversold inside a long-term uptrend is typically forced or panicked selling (liquidations, stop runs). Liquidity providers and dip buyers on the other side collect the usual partial snap-back. The source gives no mechanism beyond the ETF mean-reversion claim; this is the closest honest one.
